camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeRealtimeDeliveryAcc --region cn-hangzhou --Project Project --EndTime '2016-10-20T05:00:00Z' --LogStore LogStore --StartTime '2016-10-20T04:00:00Z' --Interval 300
description_en: Invokes DescribeRealtimeDeliveryAcc to query the number of real-time log delivery operations
description_zh: 调用DescribeRealtimeDeliveryAcc查询实时日志投递次数
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-realtime-delivery-acc --start-time 2016-10-20T04:00:00Z --end-time 2016-10-20T05:00:00Z --interval 300 --project Project --log-store LogStore --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRealtimeDeliveryAcc

parameters.help_en: The start time of the logs to retrieve. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取日志起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the logs to retrieve. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取日志结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the queried data. Unit: seconds. Valid values vary based on the time span between StartTime and EndTime:

If the time span is less than 3 days, valid values are 300, 3600, and 86400. Default value: 300.

If the time span is 3 days or more but less than 31 days, valid values are 3600 and 86400. Default value: 3600.

If the time span is 31 days or more, the valid value is 86400. Default value: 86400
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。根据您指定StartTime和EndTime两者的时间跨度，该参数取值如下：

3天以内（不包含3天整）支持300、3600、 86400，如果不传该参数，默认值为300。

3-31天（不包含31天整）支持3600和86400，如果不传该参数，默认值为3600。

31天及以上支持86400，如果不传该参数，默认值为86400
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The project for real-time log delivery. By default, all projects are queried
parameters.help_zh: 实时日志投递的Project。默认查询所有Project
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The Logstore for real-time log delivery. By default, all Logstores are queried
parameters.help_zh: 实时日志投递的Logstore。默认查询所有Logstore
parameters.name: log_store
